dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I see... and what happened after that?

dialogues.speaker: Moes
dialogues.text: Perhaps this is how the giant glaciers that lie between Snezhnaya and Nod-Krai, or separating Novokitezh from Snezhnograd, came to be.

dialogues.speaker: Moes
dialogues.text: Rumors have persisted for ages that some great secret lies hidden beneath Old Kitezhgrad. It could be true for all we know, hehe...
